title: Slice 636866: [Subcontracting] Subcontracting Summary Factbox on Released Production Order Card
summary: A read-only Subcontracting Summary FactBox was added to the Released Production Order Card showing nine order-level indicators including routing lines, purchase order quantities, received/invoiced quantities, and WIP balances with matching detail drilldowns.
key_points: New FactBox displays nine order-level indicators for subcontracting orders
Provides drilldowns to subcontracting routing lines, purchase orders, receipt lines, and invoice lines
Uses approved literal document quantity sums with signed WIP balances
Includes eligibility, refresh, and execution permissions without base app changes
32 new AL test procedures added across existing test suites
quote: Add a read-only Subcontracting Summary FactBox to the Released Production Order Card, providing nine order-level indicators with matching detail drilldowns.
